messages:
zoe: Need a microkit for the benchmark launch: hero (1200x628), three tiles (1080x1080), story (1080x1920), and a sales sticker (600x314). Locales: EN/DE. Deliver by Tue.
henry: Got it. Want A/B headlines for hero?
zoe: Yes A=product-first, B=outcome-first. Keep body same. Add alt-text and one-line social copy.
mika: I'll prepare copy keys and mark numeric strings for legal.
designbot: Export job queued id=EX999 frames=[hero_A,hero_B,tile1,tile2,tile3,story,sales-sticker] variants=[default,a11y-hc,a11y-large-type] outputs=[png:1200x628,png:1080x1080,png:1080x1920,svg]. ETA 14m. Files will be put in /figma/bench/exports/2851234567/.
legal-ops: Use qualifiers like "up to" for comparative claims and include source line: "based on internal benchmark vs baseline". Translations must match approved English strings.
a11y: For a11y-hc hit contrast >=4.5:1 and ensure text sits inside 120px safe area for stories. Provide static fallback for any animation.
ops: After final exports I can push to CDN /assets/bench/2851234567 and to sales drive. Please include manifest.json with alt-text keys.
zoe: Great. Mika please drop copy sheet by EOD so legal can review translations. Closing loop unless issues.
